oracle_definitions.D1_numeric_type: same column names and row count; every reference cell is an integer (not bool) and the aligned candidate cell is a float with float(ref) == cand; row sequence equal under numeric equality
oracle_definitions.D2_float_tolerance: same column names, row count, cell types (float) and row alignment; every aligned pair has |cand - ref| <= 1e-09 * max(1, |ref|); at least one pair has a non-zero difference
oracle_definitions.D3_row_order: same column names; identical rows including types as multisets (same multiplicities); row sequences differ; reference text has no ORDER BY / SKIP / LIMIT
oracle_definitions.D4_duplicates: same column names; reference has no duplicate rows; same set of distinct rows (types included); candidate has at least one duplicate row; candidate de-duplicated in first-occurrence order equals the reference sequence
oracle_definitions.D5_null_controlled: results identical including column names, types, row order and NULL positions; at least one NULL and at least one non-NULL value in the appended column
oracle_definitions.D6_column_name_control: study S18 T1 rule: same column count and value multiset; column names differ

label_note: D5 is a CONTROLLED FIXTURE (gold query + one appended column); D6 is a calibration control, not new evidence; equivalence classes are declared, not claims that either result is 'correct'
